messages:
sophie: Heads-up — CI is red on Windows after the bazel toolchain tweak merged this morning. Linux looks fine.

sophie: Error from the runner: 
```
ERROR: /workspace/external: no such package 'external/tools/windows_toolchain': BUILD file not found
INFO: Elapsed time: 0.12s
Target //services/edge:server failed to build
```

kevin: @sophie can you paste the exact command that failed and the bazel version from the runner? windows logs usually hide the full stack.

sophie: ran `bazel build //services/edge:server --config=windows --verbose_failures` on the CI image (bazel 6.2.0). attaching the top of the log above — the missing package is weird, looks like the new `//third_party/toolchains:windows` rename didn't propagate to the WORKSPACE.

ci-bot: Re-run requested by @kevin — starting rerun of job: build-windows-compiled (job id: 9887).

marta: Might be the patch I landed that split toolchains into `third_party/toolchains` + `platforms`. I added a `visibility` change in that PR, maybe bazel's external repo mapping changed. Quick idea: add a `bind` alias in `WORKSPACE` for backwards compat.

aj: If that's the cause we can bisect the merge window to find the exact commit. Sophie, can you try `git bisect` locally against the failing image? otherwise I can kick off a quick bisect on the CI cluster (will need ~10 runs).

sophie: I can try a local reproduce but windows images are heavy. Quick check: `bazel query 'deps(//services/edge:server)'` returns `//external:tools_windows` missing. So the rename is definitely breaking external labels.

kevin: Two quick mitigations: 1) add a `bind` in WORKSPACE redirecting `//external:tools_windows` -> `@third_party//toolchains:windows_toolchain` 2) revert the visibility rename in your patch and cut a follow-up. Which is faster?

marta: I can open a small compat PR with the bind redirect — takes 10m and should be safe. I'll also add a TODO to rip it out after 2 releases.

jen: fwiw we saw a flakey test earlier on mac build too but unrelated (timing). Not blocking this one.

ci-bot: Rerun finished: linux-build (job 9886) ✅ passed, windows-build (job 9887) ❌ failed — same missing package error.

sophie: Thanks @marta — if you can open the compat PR I'll kick the windows rerun. If it still fails I'll ask @aj to bisect.

marta: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/platform/+/1234 — adds WORKSPACE bind for backward compat. PTAL @kevin @sophie :thumbsup:

kevin: Reviewing now. If CI passes we can merge and ship the revert window.

alok: heads-up: when we revert later, please add a comment in the changelog about consumers relying on the old label. I can help track owners of dependents.

sophie: re-run kicked: ci-bot triggered by @sophie.

ci-bot: Re-run started: windows-build (job 9912).

ci-bot: Re-run finished: windows-build (job 9912) ✅ passed.

sophie: Great — merging the compat PR now. Thanks everyone. I'll open a follow-up issue to schedule the actual toolchain rename and add compatibility tests. :eyes:
